name: S.J.S. Enterprises Limited
summary: S.J.S. Enterprises Limited was founded in 1987 in Bengaluru and designs, develops and manufactures decorative aesthetic parts, mainly for automotive original equipment makers in India. Products include decals, graphics, 3D badges, appliques, dials, overlays, in-mould labels, chrome-plated parts and painted plastic components. It also sells aftermarket accessories for two-wheelers.
